nodes.name: Inspect the population
nodes.sql:
SELECT CAST(f.episode_index AS VARCHAR) AS episode_id,
'observation.image' AS stream_id, CAST(0 AS UINT32) AS segment_index,
CAST(f.frame_index AS UINT64) AS frame_index,
CAST(f.frame_index AS UINT64) * CAST(100000000 AS UINT64) AS episode_time_ns,
f."next.reward" AS recorded_reward,
f.frame_index = terminal.final_frame_index AS is_final_frame,
f."observation.state" AS state, f.action,
spql.video.decode(v.frame, 'auto') AS image
FROM (SELECT * FROM {{node:table}}) f
JOIN (SELECT episode_index, MAX(frame_index) AS final_frame_index
FROM {{node:table}} GROUP BY episode_index) terminal
ON f.episode_index = terminal.episode_index
CROSS JOIN spiral_robotics.history_fixture_video.assets a
CROSS JOIN LATERAL spql.video.frames(a.media,
spql.video.frame_indices([CAST(f."index" AS BIGINT)])) v
WHERE a.recording = 'videos/observation.image/chunk-000/file-000.mp4'
AND (f.frame_index % 10 = 0 OR f.frame_index = terminal.final_frame_index)
ORDER BY is_final_frame DESC, recorded_reward, f.episode_index, f.frame_index
LIMIT 4096
